marketing_description: The NUVO® Cloud Fixture by SATCO delivers 1,100 lumens at 12.5 W, operating on 120 V, 60 Hz with a 0.104 A draw, and features a dimmable 9.5 W LED E26 bulb with 3000 K color temperature and CRI 90+. Constructed from steel with a white acrylic lens, the flush‑mount, round 11‑inch fixture provides a durable, energy‑efficient lighting solution with an average life of 25,000 hours.
